description: Source code for calculating PDCCH aggregation levels based on CQI and other parameters in a 3GPP-compliant radio system.

methods.name: get_mcs_config
methods.description: Calculates the Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) configuration based on CQI value and MCS table.

methods.name: compute_pdcch_code_rate
methods.description: Computes the PDCCH code rate for a given aggregation level and number of DCI bits.

methods.name: does_dci_bits_fit_in_cces
methods.description: Checks if DCI bits fit within the CCEs of a specified aggregation level.

methods.name: fetch_mcs_table
methods.description: Selects the appropriate MCS table based on the CQI table provided.
